ms.promise: A technical research report on ECIES, PRE, and AES in the context of on-chain data encryption and the encryption protocol. The report will include a brief analysis of the cryptographic primitives, security model, and threat analysis for the encryption/decryption scheme. The report should describe the inner workings of the encryption protocol at a technical/semi-technical level, providing sufficient detail to explain what is happening without requiring specialized skills or knowledge.
ms.criteria:
・A detailed technical research report covering the encryption protocol, cryptographic primitives, performance considerations, security assumptions, and a threat analysis for the protocol. 
・Written as a technical report resembling a research paper.
・Publicly available via GitHub.
